parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a USB flash drive, made of durable plastic. It is small and lightweight, designed to fit snugly over the USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the USB connector from dust, moisture, and physical damage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached or reattached manually by sliding or pulling it off the connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of plastic and housing the internal memory chip and USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components for data storage and provides the interface for connecting to computers or other devices.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for insertion or removal from a USB port.
